item.description: Making a crore is still the dream of many. The bigger challenge is to make it in safe, secure and sure shot way. PPF, or Public Provident Fund, is one of the most secure investment avenues that can lead you to a crore if you are disciplined in your investments.

item.title: Hollywood power couple Jessica Alba and Cash Warren’s divorce sealed after 16 years of marriage
item.description: Jessica Alba and Cash Warren have finalised their divorce after 16 years, filing uncontested papers with no spousal support claims. The amicable pair, parents to three kids, met on Fantastic Four set and prioritise family amid new romances-Alba with Danny Ramirez, Warren with Hana Sun Doerr.

item.title: India to build its first underwater road-rail tunnel in Assam, project to cost Rs 18,000 crore

item.title: PM Narendra Modi invited for Bangladesh PM-elect Tarique Rahman’s oath ceremony: Will he attend or not?
item.description: PM Narendra Modi has been invited to attend the swearing-in ceremony of Bangladesh PM-elect Tarique Rahman on February 17. However, it is unlikely that he will fly to Dhaka for the ceremony. Instead, India is expected to send either the Vice President or the External Affairs Minister for the event. PM Modi is scheduled to meet French leader Emmanuel Macron on Tuesday.
